slice: AC1018 TABLE text-cell alignment override codec
authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.96.1

scope.writer: admits the typed alignment only when the flag is present; refuses unflagged residue and out-of-domain values
scope.reader: stores the typed value for the recognized AC1018 text-cell override profile; retains tolerant parsing but marks out-of-domain values semantically incomplete

generated_control.authenticity: locally generated codec vector; no DWG/DXF fixture
checks: raw-short field is emitted and parsed to exact typed alignment
parser body cursor matches encoded boundary
unsupported adjacent flags, invalid selected alignment, and unflagged alignment residue are atomically refused by writer

limitations: No producer-backed physical alignment witness or native CAD readback was used.
This does not resolve source-observed AC1018 cell flags 0x40000/0x40020 or their field span.
No complete TABLE graph or source-to-output equivalence is established; public dwgRW::writeTable remains fail-closed.
